summary: Before costly qualification, verify that the maintained runner actually invokes the changed assertions and that negative controls fail through that same route; compile success or a zero-test invocation does not establish executable coverage. Assemble compatible source, version, Atlas and delivery-closure changes and reconcile the intended final base before the expensive full run. Defer reporting-only followups when they would invalidate that qualification; this is not a blanket main freeze or permission to bypass required checks. Existing forward recovery retains unavailable original outcomes and reservations as Unknown without repeated unavailable-history searches. Source guidance delivery remains distinct from installed skill adoption and measured process benefit.
title: Verify executable coverage early and assemble compatible changes before costly qualification
